quest.title: Crystal Tears
quest.description: After completing the retrieval of the tears, you meet up with the rest of the group.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Mora x6000, Character EXP x3125, Fine Enhancement Ore x7

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Woohoo!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Dvalin Protection Squad! Assemble!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Let's put our crystals together.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Oh...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: The color of these crystals looks... muddy.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Dvalin... You're going through so much pain...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: #...Let's start purifying these crystals first. Please, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: It is hard to believe such a thing is possible, until you've seen it with your own eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Interesting. It's like filtering wine. The process is... refreshing.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I think we should have enough tears now. So next we...

talks.objective: Use Dvalin's Tear on the Holy Lyre

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, please replenish the Holy Lyre's power quickly!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It worked!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: It seems completely different from before.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: The lyre's Anemo power seems fully restored. We should be able to use it now.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: #It's all thanks to you, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Now, where should we summon Stormterror?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: It must be away from the city, else there will be casualties should we fail.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Perhaps here at the winery...

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: If the winery was destroyed, it's not something I couldn't eventually fix, but... I'd still rather not go through the hassle.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: The wind that blows at sea or in high places should be able to carry a bard's words far away.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: It's never going to work if the air is too dry or suffocating.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon understands. Sea or high places, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then the best location to play the lyre would be...

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: If you go east from Starfell Lake, there are mountains south of the beach.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ..Oh! You mean that beach you were snoring away on and Paimon had to wake you?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: If you head to where the cliff juts out — that place is known as <color=#00E1FFFF>Starsnatch Cliff</color>.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: What do you think, bard? Meets the requirements, no?

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Very well. Then let's meet at Starsnatch Cliff when we are ready.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Ah, sorry. I didn't mean to...

choices.text: In the sky? You could play the lyre as you're gliding through the air...

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Even Amber would never think of doing such a thing...
